intent: Same typed intent as native centre/start/end-direction clicks; backend owns all derived source. The direction click is at radius 20 mm, the actual arc remains radius 10 mm.
steps: Inspect/create one source-owned sketch on existing feature:datum with current identity/revision.
Inspect sketches, plan_sketch_edit with the operation below; preview is read-only.
apply_sketch_edit with the same edit and current opaque history; require native verification.
Create feature:pointer_body as a 6 mm NewBody extrusion using the owned closed profile.
Independently grade exact source and fresh native SI export, including absolute placement, centroid, closure and selected arc branch.
One Undo/Redo removes/restores every generated point/arc/radius.
compatibility: ADR-104: constant explicit-unit creation only, no associative helper. Three points + one ordinary CCW Arc (swap endpoint references for CW), optional two shared-ID radial lines. 4 or 6 source operations; expanded cap 64. No schema/tool-count/sampler/NURBS change; model changes use verified DesignPatch/history. MCP expresses typed intent and does not simulate a mouse.
